artboards.title: Desktop demo layout for the CEO

annotations.text:
Thesis
The unit of value is a completed action that improves an outcome, not a conversation. Everything here serves the loop: plan, decide, act, observe, repeat.

Rule
The model explains. The calculators compute. No number reaches the customer that a deterministic function did not produce first.

Rule
Nothing moves money without a confirm. Every action has before, after, who, when, and undo. Individualized investment advice escalates to a licensed human.

Why these two personas
Maya has never acted; the product must remove fear and friction. Jordan acts but does not sustain; the product must reason and stay out of the way. If the loop works for both, it generalizes.

Working name
"Mo" is a placeholder while the name is chosen. Options are in the chat.

One thread
There are no screens. These seven frames are seven stretches of the same conversation, in order. Plan, Proposal, Record, and Memory are artifacts that open beside the thread.

Borrowed from how Claude works
Visible tool calls under every claim. Collapsible thinking. Artifacts in a side panel. A permission prompt before any action, with allow once, always allow within a cap, deny. Memory as a document you can edit. Work done between sessions, posted as turns.
